name: switch_off
description: SW16 operated: Q2's gate must swing, and the cell path must not move

assert.name: the switch scenario passes
assert.because: docs/known-issues.md RESPIN: SW16 drives PWR_SW, which through R33 drives Q2's gate. The scenario checks the gate against the SI2301 model's own drive conditions.

assert.name: SW16's common drives the gate node
assert.because: on the fabricated boards this was a dead stub on BAT+, which is why the switch did nothing.

assert.name: exactly one throw is routed (pad 1 = GND = the ON position)
assert.because: pad 3 is deliberately open: with the slider there, R34 alone defines the node, which IS the OFF state.

assert.name: the ON throw drives Q2 past its characterised -4.5 V
assert.because: the SI2301 specifies R_ds(on) at V_gs = -4.5 V (q1_si2301.py v_gs_rds_on).

assert.name: the open throw leaves Q2 within 0.1 V of its source
assert.because: the threshold minimum magnitude is 0.4 V (q1_si2301.py v_gs_th_min); 22k/1k/1M keeps the worst case at -0.108 V.

assert.name: operating the switch does not move the cell
assert.because: OFF must leave the IP5306 charging — that is why the +5V rail is switched and not the battery.
